name: Release
purpose: Promote only an ST-07 Accepted Candidate through an exact human-authorized Release Plan constrained by Effective Policy, record every external effect and stable result, and advance only through the fixed ST-08 to ST-09 edge.
completion_criteria: Core deterministically records not_applicable only when ST-07 produced no Accepted Candidate, reusing the exact Review Current Evidence.

Core records reuse only when the active Accepted Candidate source revisions, Effective Policy digest, immutable Plan, human Authority, Receipt, Deployment Map, and every live external Target still match exactly.

For a Candidate, Core pins the Accepted Candidate, Effective Policy, installed Release capabilities, target observations, exact ordered steps, post-release checks, and rollback modes before any external side effect.
Every externally mutating Release Plan is authorized by an actual human decision bound to the exact Plan SHA-256, Accepted Candidate, and observed target states.
Core executes only an installed structured capability, persists immutable step receipts and provider operation identity, and never guesses or blindly repeats an ambiguous external operation.
Core creates Release Current and a JSON-only Deployment Map revision only after the released state or a completed rollback is observed, then advances through the fixed ST-08 to ST-09 edge.
stop_conditions: Review Current, Accepted Candidate, Effective Policy, capability snapshot, Release Plan, authority, target state, or referenced Evidence is missing, malformed, stale, tampered, or inconsistent.
A Candidate exists but a required source target, installed capability, exact pre-release state, post-release check, or safe rollback mode is unavailable.
The target changed after Plan review or authority, an operation result is ambiguous and cannot be reconciled, or retry would risk a duplicate external effect.
A rollback is required but was not authorized, fails, or leaves an unresolved external state.
A proposal contains an arbitrary shell command, secret value, credential material, unknown capability, Candidate mutation, or Stage transition instruction.
